speaker: john_heminges
text: The door is shut. The reckoning is done. This is the other matter.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The Mayor has written to the Lord Treasurer about yesterday. He will blame the playhouses next. He has always blamed the playhouses next.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Let him. I'm my Lord Chamberlain's man and I'll open my own doors.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Say it, then. I have heard you. I am not voting with a sentence. I am bored of a reckoning that already ended, and this is not a reckoning.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I want it written that we played old comedies and kept the peace. Written. Not shouted from a yard.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I would send to Kettleby at Greenwich before the Mayor's letter gets there. That is a door that knows what a letter is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Send if you will send. I am not calling it a decision until the door has answered, and the door is not in this room.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Margery. Come in. What is the yard, in a plain word?

speaker: margery_pell
text: Dry tinder, masters. I've stood that stair nine years.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have no jest. Do not wait for one. Nine years is her number, and I am not improving it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The only safe house in London tomorrow is a shut one, and it is Sunday, thank God.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Sunday shuts every house, mine included. Monday is the question. I have said I will open my doors. I have not been told the company agrees.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The company does not agree to that sentence. No order has shut this house. We meet Monday, and we see what Monday is.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Monday, and not a tour, and not a padlock we have not been shown. Kettleby can be written to. He cannot be made to answer tonight.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then write to him, or do not. I am not the vote. I would like the chest locked so I may go home.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Before we part. The wardrobe chests, locked with a second iron. The licensed books go home to Aldermanbury with me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the parts. Garnish carries the parts himself. I am not carrying the king anywhere tonight. What I have at the lodging does not go with the licensed books.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Garnish carries them. I will tell him. He is not wanted in this room for a speech.

speaker: will_kemp
text: No jest, and no part of mine in a locked chest that I have not seen. I am content to be useless until Monday.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Dry tinder does not become wet because a door is shut. I have told you the yard. Nine years. I am going back to the stair.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And the other question, John. You have not asked it, and the night will ask it if you do not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The country roads for July. I set the question. I do not set the answer.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Then the question stands, and my doors are not the answer to it. Not tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No answer. Monday. We see what Monday is, and we do not see it early to please a rumour.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Monday, then. I have no speech to add. God's my life, let a man go home.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Home. The second iron is the last item. No order has shut the house. Nothing else is entered.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Item, no jest. I second that item. Good night.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Good night. Greenwich can wait till a letter can actually leave.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Good night, masters. The stair is mine until I lock it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night. Sunday is a shut house. I will take that, and I will not take a road.
